newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish council says beat pillows, not children.
newsitem.headline: Turkish council says beat pillows, not children.

text.p: Beating your child for a bad school report will not only ruin his holiday, it will endanger his sanity, Istanbul's Islamist council said on Thursday.
It warned parents that every ticking off or beating for bad marks would backfire on them in later life when they had to pay for treating heart break, depression and other psychological problems.
The statement -- entitled "Don't beat your children, beat your pillows" -- was issued by the council's Children's Board, which is composed of children.
